svg.aria-label: pyrox-gauss on the GeoStack role ladder: the log density, a sample and the KL between two Gaussians as algorithms; the multivariate normals in covariance and precision form, the linear-Gaussian state-space models and their factory, the Gauss-Markov chain, the GMRF distribution and the abstract normal as models; gaussx's solver strategies, borrowed, as strategies; the moments, matrices and chain forms read off a density as primitives; lineax's and gaussx's operators and gaussx's GMRF fields, borrowed, as structure. Beside the ladder, the NumPyro calls every distribution is used through.
svg.title: pyrox-gauss on the role ladder
